snippet.title: SHERIFF VISIT + NEW QUEST CATALOG! 🤠💛 | Project Pandanda
snippet.description:
Hello there, welcome to this new video on Project Pandanda! 🌻
The Harvest Festival is still here, don’t forget to check my video about it if you haven’t already!

- Sheriff visit the island today, the 6th September, 2025 🤠
- A quick look at the update and the catalog at the end of this video!

Big love to the Project Pandanda Team – the work is absolutely amazing, we love it so much! 💛
Take care everyone!
